verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an online business filing portal, which could plausibly offer things like automatic actions on filing-status changes. The evidence only documents manual features: filing, saving drafts, checking status on the My Submissions page, and tracking filings. Nothing shows user-defined rules or automatic triggers, so the axis applies but has no support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
